description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kotakadeniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320238
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
